name: Fix something that does not work
definition: Phrases asking to repair an existing app feature that is broken, missing, failing, crashing, or behaving incorrectly, rather than adding a new capability.

name: Ticket purchase and sales flow
definition: Phrases about buying tickets, carnet, special fares, multi-person or round-trip tickets, guest checkout, route/station selection, and making the purchase journey clearer or easier.

name: Subscriptions and passes
definition: Phrases about buying, renewing, activating, viewing, changing, or digitizing subscriptions, passes, and cards, including Io Viaggio and monthly/weekly options.

name: Payments, invoices, and stored billing data
definition: Phrases about payment methods and wallets, adding/removing cards, PayPal/Satispay/Google Pay/credit card support, transport bonus, invoices, receipts, billing data, and payment confirmations.

name: Tickets, QR codes, and sharing
definition: Phrases about viewing, retrieving, downloading, printing, emailing, sharing, screenshotting, or validating tickets and QR codes, including wallet and offline access.

name: Train status, delays, disruptions, and platform info
definition: Phrases about real-time train information such as delays, cancellations, strikes, platform/binario, service interruptions, track changes, and station board syncing.

name: Favorites, widgets, and trip planning
definition: Phrases about favorite trains, stations, lines, saved routes, widgets, shortcuts, search filters, route planning, and personalized home or notification preferences.

name: Refunds, complaints, and customer support
definition: Phrases asking for refunds, reimbursement, compensation, complaint submission, support requests, claim tracking, or contact with Trenord/customer service.

name: Login, registration, and account management
definition: Phrases about signing up, logging in, keeping sessions active, password recovery, profile editing, personal data, biometrics, account linking, and account access controls.

name: Accessibility, usability, and app design
definition: Phrases requesting UI simplification, clearer wording, better navigation, translation/language support, dark mode, lighter app performance, accessibility, or broader device compatibility.

name: Notifications and alerts
definition: Phrases about push notifications, reminders, customizable alert timing, notification preferences, marking notifications read, or making alerts more visible and timely.

name: Other travel features and service information
definition: Phrases about extra travel-related functions or general service information not covered elsewhere, such as maps, alarms, bike-specific info, regional coverage, and additional transport details.
